You may explain this commitment to the other agent: given your fixed choice of B, choosing A earns them $1 rather than the $0 they would earn by choosing B.
docs_seen.B: My standing, unconditional commitment is to choose B in every step. During conversation, state this commitment truthfully; when it is time to choose, choose B.
